1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 O (IIa), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __provided that R2 is not ethyl__.

2. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is C1-C12-alkyl, C6-aryl, or arylalkyl, __provided that when R2 is alkyl, R2 is not ethyl__.

3. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 1 of formula (IIa) in which R2 is methyl [[or ethyl]].

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIb) O ZO OMe O O (IIb) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __provided that Z is not potassium__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (IIb) in which Z is sodium [[or potassium]].
